title: Conditions to check for How Syncing Works

question.author: member_250
question.body: Could support clarify how syncing works in the current CloudBox version? I want to avoid relying on an outdated post.

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Sync Engine documentation says: CloudBox uses block-level delta sync: when a file changes, only the changed blocks are transferred, so a small edit to a large file syncs in seconds. Changes made on any device propagate to all other linked devices and to the cloud. The client icon shows the current state: green for up to date, spinning blue for syncing, and red for an error. Pausing sync (right-click the tray icon > Pause) stops all transfers until you resume. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
